jp: 子供[こども]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、悪[わる]いこと{を|o-object}すれ{ば|ba-conditional}叱[しか]られます。
en: Even a child will be scolded for doing something bad.
why: A noun + といえども concedes a status that might seem to excuse the person, then states a conclusion that still applies.

jp: 専門家[せんもんか]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、ミス{を|o-object}すること{が|ga-existence}あります。
en: Even experts sometimes make mistakes.
why: Being an expert would lead us to expect no errors; といえども concedes that and says errors happen anyway.

jp: たとえ社長[しゃちょう]{といえども|toiedomo}、会社[かいしゃ]{の|no-possessive}お金[かね]{を|o-object}自由[じゆう]に使[つか]うこと{は|wa-negative}できない。
en: Even the company president cannot use the company's money freely.
why: たとえ + noun + といえども means even someone of that rank; the rule that follows still binds them.

jp: いかなる理由[りゆう]{といえども|toiedomo}、暴力[ぼうりょく]{は|wa-topic}許[ゆる]されません。
en: Whatever the reason, violence is not permitted.
why: いかなる + noun + といえども is a formal frame meaning even for any such reason; the conclusion holds without exception.

jp: 小[ちい]さな会社[かいしゃ]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、世界[せかい]{で|de-place}戦[たたか]える技術[ぎじゅつ]{を|o-object}持[も]っています。
en: Even though it is a small company, it has technology that can compete worldwide.
why: A small company would not be expected to compete worldwide; といえども concedes the size and states the surprising strength.

jp: 初心者[しょしんしゃ]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、基本[きほん]{の|no-possessive}ルール{は|wa-topic}知[し]っておくべきです。
en: Even a beginner should know the basic rules.
why: Beginner status might excuse ignorance; といえども says the obligation applies all the same.

jp: 親[した]しい友人[ゆうじん]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、お金[かね]{の|no-possessive}貸[か]し借[か]り{は|wa-topic}避[さ]けたほうがいい。
en: Even with a close friend, it is better to avoid lending and borrowing money.
why: Closeness would suggest trust; といえども concedes it and still advises caution.

jp: 天才[てんさい]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、努力[どりょく]{を|o-object}しなけれ{ば|ba-conditional}成功[せいこう]できません。
en: Even a genius cannot succeed without effort.
why: Genius suggests effort is unnecessary; といえども concedes the talent and rejects that expectation.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}人間[にんげん]です{から/ので|kara-because}、間違[まちが]えること{も|mo-also}あります。
en: Even a teacher is only human, so there are times they make mistakes.
why: The teacher's role suggests infallibility; といえども concedes the role, then the reason explains the mistakes.

jp: 年[とし]{を|o-object}取[と]った{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、まだまだ元気[げんき]です。
en: Even though I have grown old, I am still full of energy.
why: After a plain past verb, といえども concedes the fact (growing old) before denying what it would normally imply.

jp: 日本[にほん]{に|ni-location}長[なが]く住[す]んでいる{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、日本語[にほんご]{が/を|potential-ga}完璧[かんぺき]に話[はな]せるわけではありません。
en: Even though I have lived in Japan a long time, it does not mean I can speak Japanese perfectly.
why: Long residence suggests fluency; といえども concedes the residence and denies the expected conclusion.

jp: いくら忙[いそが]しい{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、家族[かぞく]{と|to-with}過[す]ごす時間[じかん]{は/を|wa-topic}大切[たいせつ]にしたい。
en: However busy I am, I want to cherish the time I spend with my family.
why: いくら + adjective + といえども means however much so; the speaker's resolve holds regardless of being busy.

jp: 外国人[がいこくじん]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、交通[こうつう]ルール{を|o-object}守[まも]らなければなりません。
en: Even foreigners must obey the traffic rules.
why: Being a foreigner might seem to be an exemption; といえども concedes the status and says the rule applies anyway.

jp: 親[おや]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、子供[こども]{の|no-possessive}日記[にっき]{を|o-object}勝手[かって]に読[よ]ん{では|te-wa}いけません。
en: Even a parent must not read a child's diary without permission.
why: A parent's authority might seem to allow it; といえども concedes the authority but still forbids the act.

jp: 疲[つか]れている{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、約束[やくそく]{を|o-object}忘[わす]れるわけにはいかない。
en: Tired as I am, I cannot afford to forget the promise.
why: Tiredness would be an excuse; といえども concedes it and says the duty remains.

jp: 一流[いちりゅう]{の|no-possessive}選手[せんしゅ]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、練習[れんしゅう]{を|o-object}怠[おこた]れ{ば|ba-conditional}腕[うで]{が|ga-subject}落[お]ちる。
en: Even a top-class player's skills decline if they neglect practice.
why: Top rank suggests immunity to decline; といえども concedes the rank and says the rule of practice still applies.

jp: 知[し]らなかった{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、違反[いはん]{は|wa-topic}違反[いはん]です。
en: Even if you did not know, a violation is still a violation.
why: Not knowing is offered as an excuse; といえども concedes it and says the violation stands.

jp: 有名[ゆうめい]な作家[さっか]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、締[し]め切[き]り{を|o-object}破[やぶ]れ{ば|ba-conditional}仕事[しごと]{が|ga-subject}来[こ]なくなる。
en: Even a famous author will stop getting work if they break deadlines.
why: Fame suggests leniency; といえども concedes the fame and states the consequence that still applies.

jp: 現代[げんだい]{の|no-possessive}技術[ぎじゅつ]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、地震[じしん]{を|o-object}正確[せいかく]に予知[よち]すること{は|wa-negative}まだできない。
en: Even with modern technology, we still cannot predict earthquakes accurately.
why: Advanced technology raises expectations; といえども concedes its level and states the limit that remains.

jp: 夫婦[ふうふ]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、もと{は|wa-contrast}他人[たにん]です。
en: Even a married couple were originally strangers.
why: Marriage suggests closeness; といえども concedes it and recalls the contrasting fact that they began as strangers.

jp: 大人[おとな]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、泣[な]きたくなる日[ひ]{も|mo-also}あります。
en: Even adults have days when they feel like crying.
why: Adulthood implies self-control; といえども concedes it and says adults too have such days.

jp: 名医[めいい]{といえども/とはいえ|toiedomo}、すべての病気[びょうき]{を/が|potential-ga}治[なお]せるわけではない。
en: Even a renowned doctor cannot cure every illness.
why: A great doctor seems all-capable; といえども concedes the reputation and states the limit.
